steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const draft = {"format":2,"id":"so-rb-readback","title":"SO-RB Readback","description":"Synthetic read-back check.","qualities":[],"checkpoints":[{"id":"start","name":"Start","type":"anchor","start":true,"objective":"Begin."}],"transitions":[],"roster":[]}; const op = { kind: 'createCharacterCard', name: 'SO-RB Ilsa', description: 'Ilsa buys anything that fell off a ship. When a seller haggles, she lowers her offer by a coin each time.', personality: 'shrewd, nervous', first_mes: 'Ilsa looks up from the counter.' }; const first = await rt.applyProvisioning(op, draft); if (!first.ok || first.readBack?.state !== 'stored' || !first.readBack.avatar) throw new Error('read-back not stored: ' + JSON.stringify(first)); const session = rt.getWizardSession('so-rb-readback'); const row = (session?.createdCards ?? []).find((c) => c.avatar === first.readBack.avatar); if (!row) throw new Error('ledger row missing: ' + JSON.stringify(session?.createdCards)); const again = await rt.applyProvisioning(op, draft); if (again.ok) throw new Error('second create was not refused'); const recheck = await rt.recheckCreatedCard(op, first.readBack.avatar, draft); if (recheck.state !== 'stored') throw new Error('recheck ' + JSON.stringify(recheck)); const missing = await rt.recheckCreatedCard(op, 'SO-RB no such card.png', draft); if (missing.state !== 'unconfirmed') throw new Error('missing avatar read back as ' + missing.state); globalThis.__rb = { avatar: first.readBack.avatar }; return { first: first.readBack, ledger: row, secondRefused: again.message, recheck: recheck.state, missingAvatar: missing.state };

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const avatar = globalThis.__rb?.avatar; if (avatar) { await fetch('/api/characters/delete', { method: 'POST', headers: ctx.getRequestHeaders(), body: JSON.stringify({ avatar_url: avatar, delete_chats: true }) }); await ctx.getCharacters(); } delete globalThis.__rb; return { removed: avatar ?? null };
